answer_1.quote: We standardized ATG as a cross-application task and developed the first benchmark dataset ... ATG aims is to model p(y|a, x).

answer_2.quote: we employed two widely used metrics in ATG: BLEU-4 (B-4) and ROUGE-1 (R-1). ... BERTScore (BS) was also used ... we introduce keyword insertion rates (KWD) and sentence length regulation compliance rates (REG).

answer_3.quote: We performed a meta-evaluation by adding a GPT-4 based evaluator to the set of the metrics used in the experiment ... The GPT-4 based evaluator was constructed by giving the same instructions as those given to the human raters in the manual evaluation.

answer_4.quote: Three human raters who are native Japanese speakers with expertise in ad annotation evaluate each of the 10 ad texts ... for each of the three evaluation aspects of faithfulness, fluency, and attractiveness.
answer_4.guideline: annotators assessed ad texts on faithfulness (does the LP imply the ad?), fluency (is it understandable and natural?), and attractiveness (pairwise comparison with human reference).
